plugin.name: Trans_Controller
plugin.author: Castiel
plugin.purpose: UI for control room in Transcendence
plugin.description: .----------------------------------------------------------------------------. | Transcendence Control Room Help | |----------------------------------------------------------------------------| |tcon help -- Brings up the help section. (What you are reading now) | | | |tcon show -- Start displaying the miniwindow. | |tcon hide -- Stop displaying the miniwindow. | |tcon reset -- Resets miniwindow position and size. | | | |tcon gag -- Gag the custom map data from the main output. | |tcon toggle -- Toggle the display of numbers on the UI if they are zero. | | | |How to use the UI: | | - Clicking anywhere on the 3x10 grid will issue a command based on which | | command is selected to the right of the grid. (It will be highlighted) | | - To change a command, just click the circle or the text next to it to the | | right of the grid. | | - The numbers on the grid are as follows: Yellow = Angels(Bad guys), Red = | | Others(Very bad guys), Green = players, White = Siege Golems(Good guys). | | - Refresh will manually send map. The circle next to it will toggle the | | automapper(Will send map every 1 second until you click the button again | | to disable it.) | | - Advance button will try to estimate where your group is and tell your | | group to move #north. Alternatively, you can click the left arrow | | buttons to manually tell your group to move to that row. | | - The 3 numbers to the left of the Update Golem Spawns button will | | determine golem spawns. Adjust these numbers using the + or -'s buttons | | above and below the numbers, then hit the Update Golem Spawns button. | | Note: These 3 numbers MUST come to a total of 9. No more, no less. | | - If you have "Observe" selected, you can click on a grid to observe it, | | but if there are 1 or more "Others" in the room, it will broadcast to | | the group so that roamers know to attack that room. | | - You can right click the header/title bar for additional options. | '----------------------------------------------------------------------------'

muclient.script:
require "serialize"
-- Window variables local z_order_plugin = "462b665ecb569efbf261422f" local dragStart = nil local window = {}
-- Drawing related variables local colours = { bgGridButton = "#333333", bgGridButtonHighlight = "#8a8a8a", bgButton = "#333333", bgButtonHighlight = "#8a8a8a", selectedCommand = "green", selectedCommandHighlight = "palegreen", selectedCommandText = "lime", header = "#474747", angels = "yellow", others = "red", players = "lime", titans = "white" } local headerSize = 20 local sizeHeight = 30 local sizeWidth = 50 local gridWidth = 0 --This will update upon drawing, needed for hotspots. local gridBottom = 0 --This will update upon drawing, needed for hotspots. local showZeros = tonumber(GetVariable("showZeros")) or 1 local gagMap = tonumber(GetVariable("gagMap")) or 0 local recoveryMax = 10 local recoveryCur = 10
-- Data variables local controllerTag = "@C[@cController@C] $C" local transData = {} local selectedCommand = 3 local golemLayout = { a = 3, b = 3, c = 3 } local dangerousMobList = { ["an angelic immolator"] = "Immolator", ["an archangel immolator"] = "Immolator", ["an archangel commander"] = "Commander", ["an angelic enchanter"] = "Enchanter", ["an angelic eliminator"] = "Eliminator", ["a seraph"] = "Seraph", ["an angelic vanquisher"] = "Vanquisher" } local dangerousMobsFound = {}
local commandTable = { --There's also "siege x y z", where x+y+z has to equal 9. This controls siege golem spawn rates per wave. Excluding because it has a different format from the others. [0] = "observe", [1] = "say water", [2] = "say lightning", [3] = "say acid", [4] = "say freeze" }
function ShowHelp() ColourNote("orange", "black", GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 3)) end
function ReportSpecials(loc, normal) EnableTrigger("TransControlSpecCap", false) local tStr = "gt " .. controllerTag .. "$C" local dMobs = "" local count = 0
for k, v in pairs(dangerousMobsFound) do if dMobs == "" then dMobs = dMobs .. "@R" .. v.amount .. " $C* @Y" .. v.name .. "@w" else dMobs = dMobs .. "$C, @R" .. v.amount .. " $C* @Y" .. v.name .. "@w" end count = count + v.amount end tStr = tStr .. "Dangerous mobs in @G" .. loc .. "$C [" .. dMobs .."$C]" if dMobs ~= "" then --We found at least one special, report it! Otherwise, ignore. Send(tStr) end end
-- ------------------------------- -- CAPTURE RELATED STUFF -- ------------------------------- function EnableCapture() EnableTriggerGroup("TransControlCapture", true) EnableTrigger("TransControlStopCap", true) end
function StopCapture() EnableTriggerGroup("TransControlCapture", false) EnableTrigger("TransControlStopCap", false) Draw(window) end
function EnableSpecCapture() EnableTrigger("TransControlSpecCap", true) dangerousMobsFound = {} end
function SpecCapture(name, line, wildcards) --Passed in: mob, health, remainder local tStr = string.lower(wildcards.mob) if dangerousMobList[tStr] ~= nil then if dangerousMobsFound[tStr] == nil then dangerousMobsFound[tStr] = { name = dangerousMobList[tStr], amount = 1} else dangerousMobsFound[tStr].amount = dangerousMobsFound[tStr].amount + 1 end end end
function LaneAOCapture(name, line, wildcards) --Passed in: lane, laneA_titans, laneA_others, laneB_angels, laneB_others, laneC_angels, laneC_others, miscData local i = tonumber(wildcards.lane) or -1 if i == -1 then print("Error in LaneAOCapture: Invalid lane") return end --Something went wrong with the lane if transData[i] == nil then print("Resetting data") ResetTransData() end
transData[i].A.angels = (tonumber(wildcards.laneA_angels) or 0) transData[i].B.angels = (tonumber(wildcards.laneB_angels) or 0) transData[i].C.angels = (tonumber(wildcards.laneC_angels) or 0)
transData[i].A.others = (tonumber(wildcards.laneA_others) or 0) transData[i].B.others = (tonumber(wildcards.laneB_others) or 0) transData[i].C.others = (tonumber(wildcards.laneC_others) or 0) end
function LanePTCapture(name, line, wildcards) --Passed in: lane, laneA_players, laneA_titans, laneB_players, laneB_titans, laneC_players, laneC_titans, miscData local i = tonumber(wildcards.lane) or -1 if i == -1 then print("Error in LanePTCapture: Invalid lane") return end --Something went wrong with the lane if transData[i] == nil then print("Resetting data") ResetTransData() end
transData[i].A.players = (tonumber(wildcards.laneA_players) or 0) transData[i].B.players = (tonumber(wildcards.laneB_players) or 0) transData[i].C.players = (tonumber(wildcards.laneC_players) or 0)
transData[i].A.titans = (tonumber(wildcards.laneA_titans) or 0) transData[i].B.titans = (tonumber(wildcards.laneB_titans) or 0) transData[i].C.titans = (tonumber(wildcards.laneC_titans) or 0) end
-- ------------------------------- -- DATA RELATED STUFF -- ------------------------------- function ResetTransData() transData = {} for i = 0, 9, 1 do transData[i] = { A = { angels = 0, others = 0, players = 0, titans = 0 }, B = { angels = 0, others = 0, players = 0, titans = 0 }, C = { angels = 0, others = 0, players = 0, titans = 0 } } end end
function GagOutput() if gagMap == 1 then SetTriggerOption("TransControlStartCap", "omit_from_output", "n") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapOne", "omit_from_output", "n") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapTwo", "omit_from_output", "n") SetTriggerOption("TransControlStopCap", "omit_from_output", "n") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapBlank", "omit_from_output", "n") ColourNote("silver", "", "Control room map will no longer be gagged.") gagMap = 0 else SetTriggerOption("TransControlStartCap", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapOne", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapTwo", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlStopCap", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapBlank", "omit_from_output", "y") ColourNote("silver", "", "Control room map will now be gagged.") gagMap = 1 end SetVariable("gagMap", gagMap) end
function ToggleNumbers() if showZeros == 1 then showZeros = 0 ColourNote("silver", "", "UI will no longer show numbers if they are zero.") else showZeros = 1 ColourNote("silver", "", "UI will now show numbers if they are zero.") end Draw(window) SetVariable("showZeros", showZeros) end
function RecoveryCountdown() recoveryCur = recoveryCur - 1
Draw(window) if recoveryCur <= 0 then EnableTimer("RecoveryCountdown", false) return end end
function SetRecovery(name, line, wildcards) --Passed: type, lane, row(All except cold) if wildcards.type == "healing" then --Healing is a 10sec recovery (Adding 1 to account for lag to both cooldowns) recoveryCur = 11 recoveryMax = 11 EnableTimer("RecoveryCountdown", true) else --lightning, acid and cold all share a 30sec recovery recoveryCur = 31 recoveryMax = 31 EnableTimer("RecoveryCountdown", true) end Draw(window) end
function StopRecovery() EnableTimer("RecoveryCountdown", false) recoveryCur = 0 Draw(window) end
function FindActiveRow() local laneID = -1 for k, v in pairs(transData) do if v.A.players > 0 and v.B.players > 0 and v.C.players > 0 then laneID = k end end return laneID end
function CountAngelsInRow(row) local tC = 0 tC = transData[row].A.angels + transData[row].C.angels + transData[row].C.angels return tC end
-- ------------------------------- -- WINDOW RELATED STUFF -- ------------------------------- function OnPluginInstall() ResetTransData() if (GetVariable("window") ~= nil) then -- load saved variables if they exist luastmt = "obj = " .. GetVariable("window") assert (loadstring (luastmt or "")) () window = obj else SetWindowDefaults() -- load window defaults end
if gagMap == 1 then SetTriggerOption("TransControlStartCap", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapOne", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapTwo", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlStopCap", "omit_from_output", "y") SetTriggerOption("TransControlCapBlank", "omit_from_output", "y") end
InitializeWindow() end
function OnPluginClose() DeleteWindow() end
function Draw(win) -- miniwin background WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , 0, 0, win.width, win.height, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor))
-- resize bars WindowLine(win.id, win.width-3, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-3, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-4, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-4, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-6, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-6, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-7, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-7, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-9, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-9, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-10, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-10, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-12, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-12, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, win.width-13, win.height-2, win.width-2, win.height-13, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor), 0, 1)
-- Header WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , 0, 0, window.width, headerSize, ColourNameToRGB(colours.header)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Transcendence Controller", (window.width)/2-(WindowTextWidth(win.id, win.font, "Transcendence Controller")/2), 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "x", window.width-15, 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "?", 5, 3, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("white"), true)
--Draw "roads" going up the columns WindowLine(win.id, 20+(sizeWidth/2), 50-headerSize+(sizeHeight/2), 20+(sizeWidth/2), 50+9*sizeHeight-headerSize , ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, 25+(sizeWidth*1.5), 50-headerSize+(sizeHeight/2), 25+(sizeWidth*1.5), 50+9*sizeHeight-headerSize , ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) WindowLine(win.id, 30+(sizeWidth*2.5), 50-headerSize+(sizeHeight/2), 30+(sizeWidth*2.5), 50+9*sizeHeight-headerSize , ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2)
--Grid Layout for i = 0, 9, 1 do local lookupI = 9-i local mod = 50 + i * sizeHeight - headerSize
if lookupI == 0 or lookupI == 4 or lookupI == 7 or lookupI == 9 then --Draw horizontal lines to indicate xroads WindowLine(win.id, 20, mod+(sizeHeight/2)+1, (sizeWidth*3) + 25, mod+(sizeHeight/2)+1, ColourNameToRGB(window.borderColor), 0, 2) end
WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill, 20, mod+1, 20+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, 20, mod+1, 20+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, lookupI, 5, mod+(sizeHeight*0.3), 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true)
if transData[lookupI].A.angels > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].A.angels, 23, mod+1, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.angels), true) end if transData[lookupI].A.others > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].A.others, 20+sizeWidth-(win.fontSize*string.len(transData[lookupI].A.others)), mod+1, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.others), true) end if transData[lookupI].A.players > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].A.players, 23, mod+sizeHeight-win.fontSize-5, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.players), true) end if transData[lookupI].A.titans > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].A.titans, 20+sizeWidth-(win.fontSize*string.len(transData[lookupI].A.titans)), mod+sizeHeight-win.fontSize-5, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.titans), true) end
local bWidth = sizeWidth + 10 + 15 WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) if transData[lookupI].B.angels > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].B.angels, bWidth+3, mod+1, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.angels), true) end if transData[lookupI].B.others > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].B.others, bWidth+sizeWidth-(win.fontSize*string.len(transData[lookupI].B.others)), mod+1, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.others), true) end if transData[lookupI].B.players > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].B.players, bWidth+3, mod+sizeHeight-win.fontSize-5, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.players), true) end if transData[lookupI].B.titans > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].B.titans, bWidth+sizeWidth-(win.fontSize*string.len(transData[lookupI].B.titans)), mod+sizeHeight-win.fontSize-5, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.titans), true) end
bWidth = (sizeWidth*2) + 15 + 15 WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) if transData[lookupI].C.angels > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].C.angels, bWidth+3, mod+1, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.angels), true) end if transData[lookupI].C.others > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].C.others, bWidth+sizeWidth-(win.fontSize*string.len(transData[lookupI].C.others)), mod+1, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.others), true) end if transData[lookupI].C.players > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].C.players, bWidth+3, mod+sizeHeight-win.fontSize-5, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.players), true) end if transData[lookupI].C.titans > 0 or showZeros == 1 then WindowText(win.id, win.font, transData[lookupI].C.titans, bWidth+sizeWidth-(win.fontSize*string.len(transData[lookupI].C.titans)), mod+sizeHeight-win.fontSize-5, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.titans), true) end
bWidth = (sizeWidth*3) + 35 WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+20, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+20, mod+sizeHeight-1, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgGridButton)) DrawArrow(win, bWidth, mod+1, 20, sizeHeight-1, "silver")
gridWidth = bWidth+sizeWidth if gridBottom <= mod+sizeHeight then gridBottom = mod+sizeHeight end end
--Column display WindowText(win.id, win.font, "A", gridWidth*0.18, gridBottom, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "B", gridWidth*0.42, gridBottom, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "C", gridWidth*0.65, gridBottom, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true)
--Refresh button WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth + 10, headerSize+10, gridWidth+70, headerSize+30, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, gridWidth + 10, headerSize+10, gridWidth+70, headerSize+30, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Refresh", gridWidth + 15, headerSize+12, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true)
--Refresh Timer button WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth+75, headerSize+10, gridWidth+95, headerSize+30, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, gridWidth+75, headerSize+10, gridWidth+95, headerSize+30, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) if GetTimerInfo("RefreshMap", 6) == true then WindowCircleOp(win.id, 1, gridWidth+77, headerSize+12, gridWidth+93, headerSize+28, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommandHighlight), 0, 2, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommand), 0) else WindowCircleOp(win.id, 1, gridWidth+77, headerSize+12, gridWidth+93, headerSize+28, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), 0, 2, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton), 0) end
--Commands local circleSize = 9 for i = 0, #commandTable, 1 do if selectedCommand == i then WindowCircleOp(win.id, 1, gridWidth + 15, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+6)), gridWidth + 15 + circleSize, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+6))+circleSize, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommandHighlight), 0, 2, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommand), 0) WindowText(win.id, win.font, commandTable[i], gridWidth + 30, headerSize+12+i+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+5)), 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommandText), true) else WindowCircleOp(win.id, 1, gridWidth + 15, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+6)), gridWidth + 15 + circleSize, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+6))+circleSize, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), 0, 2, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton), 0) WindowText(win.id, win.font, commandTable[i], gridWidth + 30, headerSize+12+i+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+5)), 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true) end end
--Cooldown time if recoveryCur > 0 then local recoveryWidth = 130 recoveryWidth = recoveryWidth * (recoveryCur/recoveryMax) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth + 10, headerSize+135, gridWidth+140, headerSize+150, ColourNameToRGB("darkslategray")) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth + 10, headerSize+135, gridWidth+10+recoveryWidth, headerSize+150, ColourNameToRGB("darkcyan")) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Skill Recovering", gridWidth + 20, headerSize+135, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true) else WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth + 10, headerSize+135, gridWidth+140, headerSize+150, ColourNameToRGB("limegreen")) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Skill is ready!", gridWidth + 25, headerSize+135, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB("black"), true) end
--Advance button if FindActiveRow() >= 0 then if CountAngelsInRow(FindActiveRow()) > 0 then WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Not clear", gridWidth + 38, headerSize+182, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true) else WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Advance[" .. FindActiveRow()+1 .. "N]", gridWidth + 38, headerSize+182, 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(window.fontColor), true) end else WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_fill , gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowRectOp(win.id, miniwin.rect_3d_rect, gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButtonHighlight), ColourNameToRGB(colours.bgButton)) WindowText(win.id, win.font, "Advance[" .. function DrawArrow(win, x, y, w, h, col) local tStr = ""
tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.20)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.50)) .. "," -- Left point tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.40)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.75)) .. "," -- Bottom pointy part tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.40)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.55)) .. "," -- Bottom pointy part reconnecting to base tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.80)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.55)) .. "," -- Right bottom corner tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.80)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.45)) .. "," -- Right top corner tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.40)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.45)) .. "," -- Top pointy part reconnecting to base tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.40)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.25)) -- Top pointy part
--If you want up arrows instead of left, comment out the above lines and uncomment the ones below.
--tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.50)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.20)) .. "," -- Top point --tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.20)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.35)) .. "," -- Left pointy part --tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.40)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.35)) .. "," -- Left pointy part reconnecting to base --tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.40)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.80)) .. "," -- Bottom left corner --tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.60)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.80)) .. "," -- Bottom right corner --tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.60)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.35)) .. "," -- Right pointy part reconnecting to base --tStr = tStr .. math.floor(x+(w*0.80)) .. "," .. math.floor(y+(h*0.35)) -- Left pointy part
WindowPolygon(win.id, tStr, ColourNameToRGB(col), 0, 3, ColourNameToRGB(col), 0, true, false) end
function InitializeWindow() WindowCreate(window.id, window.left, window.top, window.width, window.height, miniwin.pos_center_all, miniwin.create_keep_hotspots, ColourNameToRGB(window.backgroundColor)) WindowFont(window.id, window.font, window.fontFamily, window.fontSize, false, false, false, false, 1, 0) WindowPosition(window.id, window.left, window.top, miniwin.pos_stretch_to_view, miniwin.create_absolute_location)
if (window.show) then WindowShow(window.id, window.show) if (IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end Draw(window) end CreateHotSpots() end
function DeleteWindow() WindowDelete(window.id) end
function ShowWindow() window.show = true WindowShow(window.id, true) if (IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() SaveWindow() end
function HideWindow() window.show = false WindowShow(window.id, false) Draw(window) SaveWindow() end
function SaveWindow() SetVariable("window", serialize.save_simple(window)) end
function SetWindowDefaults() window = { id = "window_" .. GetPluginID(), top = 10, left = 10, width = 600, height = 400, show = true, font = "defaultFont", fontFamily = "Consolas", fontSize = 9, fontColor = "white", borderColor = "lightgray", backgroundColor = "black" } end
function ResetWindow() SetWindowDefaults() SaveWindow() InitializeWindow() Draw(window) end
function CreateHotSpots() WindowDeleteAllHotspots(window.id)
-- Drag window WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "DragArea", 15, 0, window.width-15, headerSize, "", "", "", "", "mouseup", "Drag to move", miniwin.cursor_both_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(window.id, "DragArea", "dragmove", "dragrelease", 0)
-- Resize window WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "Resize", window.width-13, window.height-13, window.width-2, window.height-2,"", "", "", "", "mouseup", "Drag to resize", miniwin.cursor_nw_se_arrow, 0) WindowDragHandler(window.id, "Resize", "resizemove", "resizerelease", 0)
-- Help button (?) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "DisplayHelp", 0, 0, 15, 15, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
-- Close button (x) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "CloseMiniwindow", window.width-15, 0, window.width, 15, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
--Grid buttons for i = 0, 9, 1 do local lookupI = 9-i local mod = 50 + i * sizeHeight - headerSize WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "TransLaneA" .. lookupI, 20, mod+1, 20+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, "", "", "", "", "gridmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
local bWidth = sizeWidth + 10 + 15 WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "TransLaneB" .. lookupI, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, "", "", "", "", "gridmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
bWidth = (sizeWidth*2) + 15 + 15 WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "TransLaneC" .. lookupI, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+sizeWidth, mod+sizeHeight-1, "", "", "", "", "gridmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
bWidth = (sizeWidth*3) + 35 WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "AdvLane" .. lookupI, bWidth, mod+1, bWidth+20, mod+sizeHeight-1, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) end
--Refresh button WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "Refresh", gridWidth + 10, headerSize+10, gridWidth+70, headerSize+30, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "RefreshTimer", gridWidth + 75, headerSize+10, gridWidth+95, headerSize+30, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)
--Command buttons for i = 0, #commandTable, 1 do WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "Command" .. i, gridWidth + 10, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(window.fontSize+6)), gridWidth+30+WindowTextWidth(window.id, window.font, commandTable[i]), headerSize+12+((i+3)*(window.fontSize+6))+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) --WindowCircleOp(win.id, 1, gridWidth + 15, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+6)), gridWidth + 15 + circleSize, headerSize+12+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+6))+circleSize, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommandHighlight), 0, 2, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommand), 0) --WindowText(win.id, win.font, commandTable[i], gridWidth + 30, headerSize+12+i+((i+3)*(win.fontSize+5)), 0, 0, ColourNameToRGB(colours.selectedCommandText), true) end
--Advance button WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "Advance", gridWidth+30, headerSize+180, gridWidth+120, headerSize+200, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)

--Siege Lane Modifiers WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "SiegePlusA", gridWidth*0.18, gridBottom+15, gridWidth*0.18+window.fontSize, gridBottom+15+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "SiegePlusB", gridWidth*0.42, gridBottom+15, gridWidth*0.42+window.fontSize, gridBottom+15+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "SiegePlusC", gridWidth*0.65, gridBottom+15, gridWidth*0.65+window.fontSize, gridBottom+15+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "SiegeNegA", gridWidth*0.18, gridBottom+45, gridWidth*0.18+window.fontSize, gridBottom+45+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "SiegeNegB", gridWidth*0.42, gridBottom+45, gridWidth*0.42+window.fontSize, gridBottom+45+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0) WindowAddHotspot(window.id, "SiegeNegC", gridWidth*0.65, gridBottom+45, gridWidth*0.65+window.fontSize, gridBottom+45+window.fontSize, "", "", "", "", "buttonmouseup", "", miniwin.cursor_hand, 0)

-- Handlers function dragmove(flags, hotspot_id) if (not dragStart) then dragStart = { x = WindowInfo(window.id, 14), y = WindowInfo(window.id, 15), } end
WindowPosition(window.id, WindowInfo(window.id, 17) - dragStart.x, WindowInfo(window.id, 18) - dragStart.y, miniwin.pos_stretch_to_view, miniwin.create_absolute_location) end
function dragrelease(flags, hotspot_id) window.left = WindowInfo(window.id, 10) window.top = WindowInfo(window.id, 11)
dragStart = nil
SaveWindow() end
function resizemove(flags, hotspot_id) window.width = WindowInfo(window.id, 17) - WindowInfo(window.id, 10) window.height = WindowInfo(window.id, 18) - WindowInfo(window.id, 11)
WindowResize(window.id, window.width, window.height, ColourNameToRGB("gray")) WindowShow(window.id, true) end
function resizerelease(flags, hotspot_id) SaveWindow() Draw(window) CreateHotSpots() end
function mouseup(flags, hotspot_id) if (bit.band(flags, miniwin.hotspot_got_rh_mouse) ~= 0) then local result = WindowMenu(window.id, WindowInfo(window.id, 14), WindowInfo(window.id, 15), "Toggle Numbers|Gag Map Output|-|Bring to front|Send to back")
if (result ~= "" and IsPluginInstalled(z_order_plugin) and GetPluginInfo(z_order_plugin, 17)) then if result == "Toggle Numbers" then ToggleNumbers() elseif result == "Gag Map Output" then GagOutput() elseif (result == "Send to back") then CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "dropMe", window.id) else CallPlugin(z_order_plugin, "boostMe", window.id) end end end end
function gridmouseup(flags, hotspot_id) local tID = hotspot_id:gsub("TransLane", "") if selectedCommand == 4 then --Freeze has a different format than the others local r = tID:sub(1, 1) Execute(commandTable[selectedCommand] .. " " .. r) else Execute(commandTable[selectedCommand] .. " " .. tID) end if selectedCommand == 0 then --Observing, check for others local r = tID:sub(1, 1) local i = tonumber(tID:sub(2, 2))
if transData[i][r].others > 0 then EnableSpecCapture() DoAfterSpecial(1, 'ReportSpecials("' .. tID .. '", ' .. transData[i][r].angels .. ')', sendto.script) end end end
function buttonmouseup(flags, hotspot_id) if string.find(hotspot_id, "AdvLane") ~= nil then local tID = hotspot_id:gsub("AdvLane", "") Send("gt " .. controllerTag .. "All lanes move north to @G" .. tID .. "N.$C") return end
if hotspot_id == "Refresh" then SendNoEcho("map") elseif hotspot_id == "RefreshTimer" then if GetTimerInfo("RefreshMap", 6) == true then SetTimerOption("RefreshMap", "enabled", "n") else SetTimerOption("RefreshMap", "enabled", "y") end Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "DisplayHelp" then ShowHelp() elseif hotspot_id == "CloseMiniwindow" then HideWindow() elseif hotspot_id == "Advance" then if FindActiveRow() >= 0 then if CountAngelsInRow(FindActiveRow()) > 0 then ColourNote("red", "", "[ERROR]: Angels are not clear. Cancelling advance message.") else Send("gt " .. controllerTag .. "All lanes move north to @G" .. FindActiveRow()+1 .. "N.$C") end else ColourNote("red", "", "[ERROR]: Active Row returned -1") end elseif hotspot_id:find("Command") ~= nil then local tID = hotspot_id:gsub("Command", "") selectedCommand = tonumber(tID) Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "SiegeUpdate" then if golemLayout.a + golemLayout.b + golemLayout.c == 9 then Execute("say siege " .. golemLayout.a .. " " .. golemLayout.b .. " " .. golemLayout.c) else ColourNote("red", "", "[ERROR]: The sum of all lanes must equal 9.") end elseif hotspot_id == "SiegePlusA" then golemLayout.a = golemLayout.a + 1 Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "SiegePlusB" then golemLayout.b = golemLayout.b + 1 Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "SiegePlusC" then golemLayout.c = golemLayout.c + 1 Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "SiegeNegA" then golemLayout.a = golemLayout.a - 1 Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "SiegeNegB" then golemLayout.b = golemLayout.b - 1 Draw(window) elseif hotspot_id == "SiegeNegC" then golemLayout.c = golemLayout.c - 1 Draw(window) end end
